title: Metric Markov cotype two of ℓ₁
description: Metric Markov cotype two: moving points on the states of a reversible Markov chain so that neighbouring states carry nearby points, at a cost controlled by the variation of the old points over a time interval. The theorem: the sequence space ℓ₁ has this property, with an explicit constant. Its proof: cuts of finitely many points, a cubic map of a cube that is flat at the vertices, a fourth-power potential, and a walk that stops at a geometric random time; the new points are means of medians of three. Also: Hilbert space, the spaces L₁(μ), complex scalars, and the extension of Lipschitz maps from subsets of Hilbert space into ℓ₁ (from one named hypothesis, the extension theorem of Mendel and Naor). The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026).

units.title: Cuts, the cubic map and a quartic potential
The stopped walk and the cotype inequality
Complex scalars, measure spaces and Lipschitz extension

prerequisites: finite sums, the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, geometric series
core course Linear Algebra (B40): the spectral theorem for symmetric matrices (first lesson, Section 3; fourth lesson, Section 3)
core course Measure and Integration (D10): integrable functions (fourth lesson, Section 2 only)
